references.title: Solving MaxSAT and #SAT on structured CNF formulas
references.note: Primary source defining PS-width and proving #SAT and weighted MaxSAT in O(k^3 s(m+n)) when a width-k decomposition is supplied.

references.title: Understanding model counting for beta-acyclic CNF-formulas
references.note: Primary source proving polynomial beta-acyclic #SAT by elimination and showing that PS-width dynamic programming does not cover all structurally tractable formulas.

references.title: Non-FPT lower bounds for structural restrictions of decision DNNF
references.note: Primary lower-bound source separating incidence-treewidth structure from restricted decision-DNNF and OBDD compilation guarantees.

references.title: On complexity of restricted fragments of Decision DNNF
references.note: Current primary source refining restricted decision-DNNF lower-bound methodology and relaxed structured compilation models.
